warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS"
notes: A photograph of a printed keg collar lying on concrete, not flat artwork, so the small type is soft and the disc is slightly tilted.

net_contents is null because the collar declares no single quantity. It preprints four sizes on four lines - '15.5 US GALLONS', '10.8 US GALLONS', '7.75 US GALLONS', '5.16 US GALLONS' - and a hand-drawn stroke crosses the '7.7' of the third. The stroke could be a tick selecting that size or a line cancelling it; the image does not settle which, so no value is recorded rather than a guess.
The brand is handwritten in marker, 'I Heard Cassarole', below the net-contents list. The final letter of 'Cassarole' is a loop that could also be read as 'u'.
The printed brewery logo reads 'Mash Cult' over 'Brewery' in a handwriting-style face, at the top centre. It is the other name on the collar.
The alcohol statement is part printed, part handwritten: printed 'ALC. / VOL.', then '8.0' in marker, then a printed '%'.
Other handwritten fields: 'BATCH # 003', 'BORN ON: 8/26/26', and 'STYLE: Double India Pale Ale'.

The warning body is in capitals and ends 'HEALTH PROBLEMS' followed by a raised mark that reads as a closing double quote rather than a full stop. No opening quote appears before the heading. At this photo resolution the mark cannot be resolved further; it is transcribed as printed.
